title: Iron Lodestones Backport
description: Lodestones use iron instead of netherite (backported from 1.21.5)
body:
Iron Lodestones Backport is a simple datapack that replaces changes the lodestone crafting recipe to use iron rather than netherite. This is a backport of a change in 1.21.5.

It is intended to support every version that contains lodestones until the vanilla change. It has been tested on these versions:
```
20w13a
1.16
1.20.4
24w07a
24w09a
1.20.6
24w20a
24w21a
1.21
1.21.1
24w33a
1.21.4
```
These versions were selected on account of being before or after relevant datapack changes, so it should cover all versions in between, but I can't promise 100% certainty to work with _every_ version. Note: Some of these versions will indicate that the pack is made for a newer version of Minecraft; that is known to occur on some working versions, so it is not a sufficient indicator of failure.
